messages:
sophia: Heads-up — seeing 150–300ms tail latency on long-chat sessions when KV memory hits ~95% under high qps. Pattern looks tied to evictions, not network.

sophia: Repro steps: heavy multi-turn >12k tokens, simultaneous 30 reqs/s, KV_MODE=FIFO.

dylan: @sophia can you drop the perf profile and allocator stats? FIFO under pressure could be making large tombstones?

sophia: Paste of top lines from the pprof heap at 95%: 
```
alloc_objects: 12.3M
kv_entries: 9.8M
frag_ratio: 0.48
evict_ops/sec: 4200
avg_evict_latency_ms: 0.9
```

raul: That frag_ratio is suspicious. FIFO can leave fragmented slabs if reinserts happen right after eviction. We saw similar in a local repro months ago but not this magnitude.
kai: Do we have per-slab histograms? I bet long contexts cause partial cache retention that prevents whole slab reuse.

ciara: Also noticed kernel selection shift around the same time: small attention kernel started hitting slower path when sequence lengths > 8k. Could be correlated with longer KV scans increasing GC pressure.

evans: quick flamegraph link: https://perf.example/fg/abc123 (private) — shows a flat spot in `kv::evict_one()` -> `slice_move()` during spikes.
dylan: TL;DR hypothesis: FIFO eviction + reinserts -> many small tombstones -> allocator searches -> eviction loop spends cycles scanning metadata -> tail latency spike.

sophia: I tried switching to LRU locally, same load: peak latency drops ~70ms and avg evict latency halves, but cpu goes up ~12%.
kai: Please capture a short syscall trace next time. If allocator does repeated `madvise`/`munmap` that's a red flag.

ciara: Could we try a hybrid: FIFO for hot slabs, LRU for the rest? Or add an eviction hysteresis window to avoid immediate reinsert churn for ephemeral keys.

evan: +1 on hysteresis. Also add sampling when cache >90% to skip full eviction scans and pick random candidate then validate list size. Cheap and often fixes pathological scans.

ops-bot: deploybot: canary toggled `KV_EVICT_ALGO=hybrid-sample` to staging at 2026-03-18T12:34:56Z by @dylan :rocket:

sophia: Canary numbers look promising: 60% fewer eviction loop ns and tail latency down ~120ms under same repro.
dylan: Plan: 1) instrument per-slab fragmentation histograms, 2) add reuse-window config, 3) land sampled eviction fallback, 4) followup perf regression test for long contexts. I filed infra ticket: https://rwd/infra/issue/4521

raul: I'll add a microbenchmark for reinserts to the perf suite. If we catch it early we avoid regressing later.
sophia: Thanks team — keeping this thread for quick notes. Will post postmortem if anything new. :thumbsup:
